about_the_game:
Catgirl Gemfall is an all new coin pusher game that combines ultra rare trading cards with addictive scoring gameplay. It's a dopamine machine.

Drop enchanted coins into a magical pusher packed with traps, treasures, and Catgirl guardians. Trigger streaks, morphs, and explosive chain reactions as gems tumble, multiply, and rain down the board. Summon the Gem Fairy, unlock streak combos, and ride a wave of shiny destruction to fight against the evil spreading corruption.

The definitive Catgirl-arcade coin-pusher experience.

🐾 Score big by chaining gem falls, streak multipliers, and morph effects.
💎 Unlock new arenas, from cursed castles to treasure caverns overflowing with magical loot.
😼 Outsmart rival catgirls guarding the lanes and turn their tricks into your treasure.
✨ Unleash abilities: icy blasts, magnetic pulls, gem storms, and morphing coins that defy the rules of physics.

Every drop is a new disaster (or jackpot) waiting to happen.

Deploy skill (and a little luck) to:

  • Flood the board with gem storms and fairy blessings

  • Morph silver coins into ingots, magnets, or gem-spawning chaos

  • Exploit physics, edges, and pushers for maximum sparkle

Drop coins, cause chaos, and let the gems fall — Catgirl Gemfall isn’t just about shiny treasures. It’s about saving the Catgirls, building a team and saving the world!
